semantic_fragments.content: Clauses 15.5.1.1 through 15.5.3 covering transformer overheating protection, short circuit tests, overload tests, high-frequency transformer dielectric tests, and transformer means of protection are all marked N/A because no transformer is used in the ME equipment.
Clause 16 (ME SYSTEMS) and its subclauses 16.1 and 16.2 are all marked N/A with the remark 'Not ME systems', indicating the device under test is not part of a ME SYSTEM configuration.

For ME SYSTEMS (Clause 16.1): RISK MANAGEMENT methods, optionally, used by MANUFACTURER of an ME SYSTEM reconfigurable by RESPONSIBLE ORGANIZATION or OPERATOR to determine configurations with highest RISKS and measures to ensure any configuration of ME SYSTEM will not present unacceptable RISKS.
